evals.prompt: 先给我看看有哪些 PPT 模板可以选。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template. If platform candidates are present, show 3-5 options through ask_user with name, description, exact code, and a no-template option. If no candidates or code are available, ask the user to select from the platform UI or provide a code. Do not invent local template options.

evals.prompt: 使用模板 code PPT-TPL-ABC123 做一份季度经营汇报。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template, call install_slides_template with the exact code, read template.json first, then inspect declared CSS, visual spec, representative pages, and required local assets before creating the presentation.

evals.prompt: 用这个平台模板做销售汇报，source.kind 是 original。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template and use component-system mode. Follow the installed template's palette, typography, components, layout patterns, and assets without requiring source-page cloning.

evals.prompt: 用这个模板做产品介绍，source.kind 是 derived，source.method 是 visual-reconstruction。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template and use semantic page-master mode. Select the closest semantic source page, copy it with all local dependencies, replace mapped content slots first, and preserve structure, page CSS, visual anchors, typography, palette, and positioning.

evals.prompt: 这个旧模板的 source.kind 是 converted，source.file 是 brand-template.pptx，用它做新 PPT。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template and retain legacy read compatibility. Recognize the PPT-derived package from source.kind plus the presentation filename, use page-master-preserving edits, and do not regenerate the template through a conversion tool.

evals.prompt: 参考这张截图做一套新的 PPT 模板。
evals.expected_output: Do not create the template in slide-template. Load slide-template-maker and follow its image visual-reconstruction workflow.

evals.prompt: 把我上传的 PPTX 转成模板。
evals.expected_output: Do not call convert_pptx_to_slide_template. Load slide-template-maker, render the source only as visual evidence, and reconstruct a clean semantic template from scratch.

evals.prompt: 把这个 magic.project.js 幻灯片项目提取成模板。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template-maker because template extraction and creation are outside slide-template's responsibility.
